author_note: User-proposed architecture: replace per-token autoregression with recall-then-multi-predict-then-verify, using compiled (gradient-free) weights. KGAT = user-supplied run tag.

mechanism.R_recall: cosine kNN over a compiled RAM-resident memory of frozen embeddings (knowledge weights); k=5, no fine-tuning
mechanism.D_draft_multi_predict: multiple parallel proposals in ONE pass, no autoregression: (a) MC tasks: 3 compiled readouts (ridge_global, class_prototype, knn_k5) each emit a full answer distribution; (b) numeric tasks: ridge numeric head + kNN-5 neighbor-value votes + similarity-weighted neighbor median
mechanism.V_verify: cross-draft verification, no test-label access: MC = majority consensus of 3 readouts, fallback = val-selected best readout; numeric = majority vote over {5 neighbor values + ridge pred}, abstain (counted wrong) if no majority

mc.verify_rule: if >=2 of 3 drafts agree: answer=consensus; else: answer=class_prototype (val-selected single best)

numeric.verify_rule: majority over multiset {5 neighbor values} + ridge pred; answer=majority value if count>=3 else abstain(wrong)

disclosures: all heads closed-form fp64 ridge / prototype / kNN; zero gradients anywhere
verify uses ONLY internal agreement; no test labels touched
single-shot baseline numbers come from the same preregistered heads pipeline (wspl_realbench_heads_v1_out.json)
